## Audit Complete

**Finding**: Field key mismatch in counter particle (line 35)

**Defect**: `new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_peruk08_px1.dart:35 · counter particle filter uses scoped field name תיק האם כבר פנו למוכר instead of unscoped האם כבר פנו למוכר · P1 wrong result · change r[gen_app_peruk08_px1_c123] to r[gen_app_peruk08_px1_c13]`

**Details**: The counter particle "לא פנו" filters records using a scoped field name (`תיק האם כבר פנו למוכר`), but the table on the same screen accesses the same field with an unscoped name (`האם כבר פנו למוכר`). AppStore records are keyed by unscoped field names. This causes the filter to always fail: `r['תיק האם כבר פנו למוכר']` returns `null`, leading to `null ?? '' == 'לא'` → always `false`. The counter will always report 0.

**Why police didn't catch this**: The code compiles validly (null-safety satisfied by `??` operator), but the logic is semantically broken at runtime.

**Coverage**: Verified enum creation (3 values ✅), spec syntax valid ✅, Dart compilation ✅. Could not test runtime behavior without Flutter execution. All other code correctly uses unscoped field names for record access.

Report written to `./_audit-compile.md`.
